verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm Elastic serves a live llms.txt at elastic.co/llms.txt that references its observability solutions. They also confirm Markdown versions of the observability docs (observability.md), so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable docs directly. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and Markdown-docs offering and its coverage, and evidence of how thoroughly the observability docs set is indexed for agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.elastic.co/llms.txt # Elastic
